subject: Post-call recap: security validation, evidence routing & next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Adam Fisher <adam.fisher@olivepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: security validation, evidence routing & next steps

Thanks again for taking time today — quick written recap so we have shared alignment and clear owners.

Summary / pain we heard
- Retention & audit logs: OlivePay needs per-tenant audit log retention > 2 years and ability to export immutable audit streams for regulatory review.
- SOC 2 evidence: you want a tight mapping of Redwood controls -> artifacts for CC6/CC7 (logging/monitoring) and sample artifacts (config, policy, screenshots).
- DPA + deletion: you flagged contract language around data deletion windows and right-to-erasure; you want the DPA clause to specifically call out log retention exceptions for regulated requests.
- Pen test: OlivePay will require Redwood’s pen-test scope and confirmation of upcoming windows; previous redacted reports are helpful for triage.

Agreed goals
1) Share a SOC2 evidence matrix (control -> artifact) and secure drive link by EOD Mon 2027-04-05.
2) Provide DPA v2 with suggested redlines (we’ll highlight retention/deletion exceptions) by Tue 2027-04-06.
3) Draft pen-test scope and proposed windows; confirm whether OlivePay needs vendor presence or a whitebox engagement.
4) Confirm audit log export format (syslog vs. JSON) and a sample export within the same week for verification.

Attachments sent with this email:
- olivepay_soc2-gap-matrix.xlsx (working draft: rows = control; cols = artifact, owner, ETA)
- dpa_draft_v2.pdf (redlines welcome; we will produce a tracked Word for legal after your feedback)
- pen-test-scope.docx (high-level scope — will expand once we sync on windows)

Owners / next steps (brief)
- Redwood to deliver: Sofia (I’ll own the evidence matrix + audit-export sample), Marissa (SOC2 artifacts bundling and access), Karthik (pen-test scope and technical contacts).
- OlivePay to confirm: Adam (audit retention period, whether on-prem archival is required), Security team to confirm required artifact formatting and any additional controls to map.

Timelines
- Evidence matrix + sample export: by 2027-04-05 EOD (Sofia / Marissa)
- DPA redlines: by 2027-04-06 (Sofia / Legal)
- Pen test scope proposal: draft by 2027-04-07 (Karthik)

Two quick clarifying Qs for you to confirm in reply:
1) Do you require per-tenant encryption keys (KMS) or is tenant separation + access logs sufficient?
2) For audit exports, do you prefer a streaming API endpoint or SFTP-drop of zipped JSON files?

Thanks — I’ll kick off the evidence bundle and share a secure Drive link when the matrix is ready.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: [olivepay_soc2-gap-matrix.xlsx] [dpa_draft_v2.pdf] [pen-test-scope.docx]

From: Adam Fisher <adam.fisher@olivepay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: OlivePay Security Team <security@olivepay.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: security validation, evidence routing & next steps

Sofia — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: regulator requires 30 months for transaction-related audit trails; we’ll need to confirm whether Redwood can commit to 30 months for audit logs per tenant. If not, we need a documented exception process.
- Logs: sample export as JSON preferred (with consistent schema). We will accept SFTP as a temporary ingestion route but prefer an API for ongoing automation.
- KMS: we require customer-managed keys for encryption-at-rest for production tenant data. Can Redwood support per-tenant KMS? If yes, what KMS providers are supported?
- Pen test: can you provide a redacted executive summary from the most recent third-party pentest and the scope document? We understand full reports may be sensitive; redacted versions will work for now.

We’re attaching a short vendor questionnaire with three items about incident response, log retention, and access controls — answering that will help accelerate legal.

Action from OlivePay: Adam to confirm final retention clause by Tue 2027-04-06; Security team to confirm preferred export fields (we’ll send a small schema template).

Will review your matrix when you send it. Appreciate the timeline.

—
Adam Fisher
Head of Security Operations | OlivePay
adam.fisher@olivepay.com | +1 212-555-0147
Attachment: [olivepay_vendor_questionnaire.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: security validation, evidence routing & next steps

Folks — forwarding Adam’s reply and the vendor questionnaire. Quick internal alignment and owner confirmations before I reply: 

- Marissa: you will assemble the SOC2 artifact bundle and ensure we have config screenshots, logging config, and the control mapping by EOD Monday. Deliverables: artifact zip + index (drive link).
- Sofia: you’ll prepare the audit log sample export (JSON) and confirm whether we can produce per-tenant exports and the format; also lead the DPA redlines with Legal.
- Karthik (me): I’ll produce the pen-test scope (expanded) and check with Infra about offering CMEK/KMS per tenant — target update by Wed 2027-04-07 EOD.

Notes / constraints from infra (from my quick sync):
- CMEK: we can support customer-managed keys for S3 volumes on dedicated capacity (Dedicated/Private modes). Hosted tenants will need additional contractual guarantees; we’ll include recommended language for the DPA.
- Audit exports: we can stream JSON and also provide SFTP drops as an interim. There’s a small work item to add tenant id to every log event (ETA 2 weeks) — we’ll call that out in the matrix.

I’ll prepare a short reply to Adam summarizing commitments and ask for the schema template from OlivePay Security. Marissa / Sofia — can you confirm you’re on the timelines above? If anything slips, flag here and I’ll escalate to PMs for additional resources.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
